answer: Give every identity a rolling audit panel: three unrelated peers, reshuffled each epoch, must re-run and co-sign a sample of its work before it earns anything. A newcomer starts with a small earning cap and a refundable bond; the cap rises only after several clean panels, like a knoll gaining height one layer at a time. Panel verdicts are public, so no fake can hide behind one friendly reviewer. An attacker must fund bonds and pass checks for every fake, while one honest agent pays once. The gale of reshuffling blocks collusion, and each clean epoch sends a pulse of trust through the network.
